decks.notes: This deck focuses on quickly deploying threats like Delver of Secrets, Murktide Regent, and Dragon's Rage Channeler to apply pressure on the opponent and disrupt their game plan. By utilizing efficient counter spells like Force of Will and Daze, along with powerful removal like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat, the deck aims to control the pace of the game while maintaining a strong board presence. The deck also includes card draw and selection spells like Brainstorm and Expressive Iteration to ensure consistent draws and maximize the efficiency of its threats and answers.

The main concept of this Grixis Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan while controlling the board with removal spells and counterspells. Using cards like Thoughtseize and Force of Will, the deck aims to keep the opponent's threats in check while generating card advantage with the help of planeswalkers like Jace, the Mind Sculptor and Narset, Parter of Veils. Hidetsugu Consumes All acts as a win condition, while Baleful Strix provides card advantage and board presence. The deck runs a tight mana base to ensure consistent access to all colors of mana.

The deck focuses on generating value from artifacts and using them to control the game while also applying pressure to the opponent with aggressive creatures. It utilizes fast mana sources like Mox Opal and Lotus Petal to power out threats quickly and disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Chalice of the Void and Force of Will. Emry, Lurker of the Loch acts as a recursive threat and card advantage engine, while Urza's Saga provides additional artifact support. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent by efficiently using artifacts for both offense and defense.

The deck focuses on generating mana quickly through creatures like Nettle Sentinel and Heritage Druid, then utilizing cards like Glimpse of Nature and Green Sun's Zenith to draw through the deck and find key cards like Craterhoof Behemoth or Natural Order to win the game quickly. The deck also includes disruption in the form of Allosaurus Shepherd to protect its combo pieces. It aims to overwhelm the opponent with a rapid swarm of elves and finish them off with a huge attack powered by Craterhoof Behemoth.

The deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana using artifacts like Mox Opal and Lotus Petal to play powerful artifact creatures and spells. Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Urza, Lord High Artificer synergize well with artifacts, fueling card draw and generating value. Chalice of the Void shuts down opponent's low-casting-cost spells while Force of Will provides protection. Urza's Saga helps to tutor for key artifacts and lands, while generating tokens. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of fast mana production, disruptive spells, and powerful artifact creatures.

The main strategy of this aggressive Burn deck is to consistently deal damage to the opponent through direct damage spells like Lightning Bolt, Lava Spike, and Chain Lightning. The creatures like Monastery Swiftspear, Eidolon of the Great Revel, and Goblin Guide help apply pressure early on. The aim is to quickly reduce the opponent's life total to zero by utilizing efficient burn spells and getting in attacks with the creatures. The deck aims to win the game quickly before the opponent has a chance to stabilize or gain control of the board.

The key concept of this deck is to maintain tempo and aggressive pressure through efficient spells and creatures. By combining disruptive elements like Force of Will and Wasteland with powerful threats like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Murktide Regent, the deck aims to control the game while dealing consistent damage to the opponent. The deck's card selection tools such as Brainstorm and Ponder, along with its ability to protect its threats with counterspells like Daze, allow it to maintain its aggressive strategy while disrupting the opponent's game plan.

The deck focuses on quickly playing threats like Delver of Secrets, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Murktide Regent to apply pressure on the opponent. It aims to control the opponent's resources with counterspells like Force of Will and spell disruption while also using efficient removal like Lightning Bolt. The deck is designed to be fast and aggressive, using tempo plays and resource denial with cards like Daze and Wasteland to prevent the opponent from stabilizing or mounting a defense. The inclusion of Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration helps to maintain card advantage and card selection.

The deck focuses on utilizing artifacts to generate card advantage and tempo while disrupting the opponent with counter magic. By using cards like Urza's Bauble and Mishra's Bauble to draw cards and Mox Opal to ramp, the deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with powerful artifact creatures like Kappa Cannoneer and Thought Monitor. Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Sai, Master Thopterist provide additional value by recurring artifacts and generating Thopter tokens. The deck also utilizes Urza's Saga to tutor for key artifacts and generate additional value.

This deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly by utilizing aggressive artifact creatures and powerful artifacts such as Urza's Saga. It focuses on creating a wide board presence while disrupting the opponent with cards like Chalice of the Void and Force of Will. Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Sai, Master Thopterist provide additional value and card advantage, while Urza's Bauble and Mishra's Bauble help to replace themselves and keep the deck running smoothly. The deck aims to win the game through a combination of fast attacks and strategic disruption.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through disruption and card advantage, utilizing counterspells like Force of Will and Force of Negation alongside powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler and Narset, Parter of Veils. Standstill is used to further slow down the opponent while drawing cards. The combination of efficient removal like Swords to Plowshares and Prismatic Ending, as well as board wipes like Supreme Verdict, helps the deck maintain control over the board. Timeless Dragon provides a powerful late-game threat, while Shark Typhoon offers a versatile win condition. The mana base is designed to ensure consistency and flexibility in casting spells.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly get powerful creatures into the graveyard, then use reanimation spells like Reanimate and Exhume to bring them back onto the battlefield for a low cost. This allows the player to cheat out expensive creatures like Griselbrand and Iona, Shield of Emeria early in the game, overwhelming the opponent with powerful threats. The deck also includes disruptive cards like Grief and Thoughtseize to disrupt the opponent's game plan, giving the reanimator player time to set up their combo and win the game.

The main strategy of this UR Tempo deck is to play aggressive creatures like Murktide Regent and Dragon's Rage Channeler early on, supported by efficient counterspells like Daze and Force of Will to protect them. Delver of Secrets helps maintain pressure on the opponent while cantrips like Brainstorm and Ponder ensure card selection and consistency. Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning provide additional reach to close out games quickly. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Wasteland and Brazen Borrower to further disrupt the opponent's game plan.

The main focus of this deck is to aggressively play creatures like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler early in the game, while controlling the board using counterspells like Force of Will and removal spells like Lightning Bolt. The deck aims to maintain tempo by disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Daze and Wasteland, while also drawing into more threats and answers with cards like Brainstorm and Expressive Iteration. The deck's strategy revolves around applying pressure to the opponent and winning the game quickly before they can establish their own game plan.

This UR Tempo deck focuses on controlling the board while putting pressure on the opponent with efficient creatures like True-Name Nemesis and Delver of Secrets. The deck utilizes versatile spells like Force of Will and Lightning Bolt to disrupt the opponent's game plan and protect its own creatures. Additionally, the deck includes card advantage engines like Snapcaster Mage and Brainstorm to maintain tempo and outvalue the opponent. The mana base is designed to support both the aggressive and controlling aspects of the deck, allowing for flexibility in adapting to different matchups.

This UWx Control deck aims to disrupt and control the opponent's game plan by utilizing a variety of counterspells, removal spells, and card draw engines. The deck focuses on protecting its threats while gradually increasing its advantage through card selection and incremental value. With a mix of powerful planeswalkers, efficient removal, and versatile counterspells, this deck aims to outvalue and outlast the opponent, ultimately grinding them out of resources and securing victory through superior card advantage and control of the battlefield.
